description: This Java source file defines the 'SamplingConfiguration' class, which manages configuration for performance sampling, including loading classes to sample, checking if sampling is enabled, and retrieving sampling rates and reset periods.

classes.name: SamplingConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class that manages performance sampling settings including loading classes to sample, checking if sampling is enabled, and retrieving sampling parameters.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the sampling configuration by loading class names specified in the properties to the `classesToSample` set.

methods.name: isSamplingConfiguredForClass
methods.description: Checks if sampling is configured for a specific class, by verifying if any loaded sample class is assignable from the given class.

methods.name: isSamplingEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether sampling is enabled based on the properties configuration.

methods.name: getSamplingRate
methods.description: Returns the sampling rate as configured.

methods.name: getResetPeriod
methods.description: Returns the duration after which sampling resets, based on the configured reset period in seconds.
